candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis requires synchysis scintillans (iridescent anterior chamber crystals = cholesterolosis), morning glory disc anomaly, and chronic retinal detachment. C001 captures all three core components plus the associated hemorrhagic findings. Cholesterolosis of the anterior chamber is an accepted alias for synchysis scintillans in this context.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Includes morning glory disc anomaly, chronic retinal detachment, vitreous hemorrhage, hyphema, and cholesterolosis of anterior chamber (synchysis scintillans = cholesterolosis bulbi/anterior chamber cholesterolosis); all required components present

candidate_relations.reason: Cholesterolosis bulbi is a well-established synonym for synchysis scintillans. Combined with morning glory disc anomaly and chronic retinal detachment, all three required components of the reference diagnosis are present.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Morning glory disc anomaly + chronic retinal detachment + cholesterolosis bulbi; cholesterolosis bulbi is a recognized synonym for synchysis scintillans

candidate_relations.reason: All three required components are present. Secondary anterior chamber cholesterolosis maps to synchysis scintillans. The additional hemorrhagic details are consistent with the clinical record.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Systemic metabolic disorder causing oxalate crystal deposition; unrelated to the described ocular findings
